title: 3D QMY Coins, Luxury Home Page, Scroll-to-Title, Remove Caffeine References

requirements.summary: Replace floating coin images with 3D rendered QMY coins using React Three Fiber
acceptanceCriteria: No tags or CSS background-image rules are used for the floating coins on the Home page
At least 5 QMY coins are rendered as 3D disc/coin meshes using React Three Fiber with a gold metallic PBR material
'QMY' text or embossed lettering is visible on the coin face
Coins float and drift smoothly across the space background with gentle rotation animations
The Three.js canvas overlays the existing SpaceBackground without breaking the rest of the page layout

file_operations.description: Create a React Three Fiber component that renders at least 5 realistic 3D QMY coin meshes. Each coin must be a disc/cylinder shape with 'QMY' embossed text on the face, using a gold metallic PBR material (MeshStandardMaterial with metalness ~0.8, roughness ~0.2, and gold color #FFD700). Implement smooth floating and drifting animations using useFrame for position updates and gentle rotation. Position coins at varied depths and locations to create a distributed 3D effect across the viewport.

Remove all existing elements and CSS-based coin animations from the floating coins section. Import and integrate the new FloatingQMYCoins component wrapped in a Canvas from @react-three/fiber. Position the Canvas as an overlay layer above the SpaceBackground (using absolute positioning with appropriate z-index) while preserving the existing page layout and content. Ensure the Canvas is non-blocking (pointer-events: none) so underlying content remains interactive. Remove any references to frontend/public/assets/generated/icp-coin-gold.dim_128x128.png and frontend/public/assets/generated/qmy-coin-gold.dim_128x128.png used for floating coins.

requirements.summary: Apply luxury aesthetic to Home page with rich gold, deep black, champagne palette and glass-morphism design
acceptanceCriteria: Home page uses a dark luxury color palette (deep blacks, rich golds, champagne accents) throughout
Headings use the Cinzel serif font with gold color
Section cards or panels use glass-morphism or dark velvet surfaces with gold border accents
Gold glow/shimmer effects are applied to primary CTA buttons and key headings
Overall visual impression is premium and elegant, not generic or playful

file_operations.description: Apply luxury aesthetic styling throughout the Home page. Use deep blacks (#0A0A0A, #1A1A1A) as base backgrounds. Apply Cinzel font to all headings with gold color (#FFD700). Wrap section content in cards with glass-morphism effect (backdrop-blur, semi-transparent black background with alpha 0.3-0.5, gold border-b or border accent). Add gold glow effects to primary CTA buttons using box-shadow with gold (#FFD700) at multiple layers for shimmer. Use champagne (#F5DEB3) for secondary accents. Apply refined spacing (larger gaps, generous padding) to create an exclusive, high-end feel. Ensure typography hierarchy emphasizes elegance with appropriate font weights and letter-spacing.

Add or update CSS custom properties and utility classes for the luxury aesthetic. Define --luxury-black (#0A0A0A), --luxury-gold (#FFD700), --luxury-champagne (#F5DEB3), --luxury-deep-black (#1A1A1A). Add .glass-morphism utility class with backdrop-filter: blur(10px), background: rgba(0,0,0,0.4), border: 1px solid rgba(255,215,0,0.3). Add .gold-glow utility with multi-layer box-shadow for shimmer effect. Ensure these styles complement existing space theme without breaking other pages.

requirements.summary: Implement auto-scroll on Home page load to reveal main title
acceptanceCriteria: On initial page load, the Home page auto-scrolls so the main hero title is at or near the top of the viewport
Any content above the title (e.g. a spacer or pre-hero element) is scrolled out of view automatically
The user can scroll back up to see content above the title
The scroll behavior is smooth, not instant/jarring

file_operations.description: Add a useEffect hook that runs once on component mount to implement auto-scroll behavior. Use a ref on the main hero title element. In the useEffect, after a brief delay (200-300ms to allow rendering), call scrollIntoView on the title ref with { behavior: 'smooth', block: 'start' } to smoothly scroll the title to the top of the viewport. Ensure this only runs on initial load by using an empty dependency array. Add a spacer div above the title (min-height: 40vh or similar) so there is content to scroll past, making the title the first prominent visible element after auto-scroll while still allowing users to scroll back up.

requirements.summary: Remove all 'Caffeine' references from Footer and other frontend files
acceptanceCriteria: The Footer component contains no visible 'Caffeine' text or branding
No other rendered page or component shows the word 'Caffeine' to end users
Any 'Powered by' or attribution lines that referenced Caffeine are removed or replaced with a neutral/Quantumoney attribution

file_operations.description: Remove all occurrences of the word 'Caffeine' from visible text, branding, or attribution in the Footer component. If there is a 'Powered by Caffeine' or similar line, remove it entirely or replace with a neutral attribution like '© 2025 Quantumoney' or leave blank. Ensure no user-facing text in the Footer references Caffeine.

Search for and remove any visible 'Caffeine' references in the Layout component. Check for any attribution text, comments rendered to DOM, or metadata that might display 'Caffeine'. If none exist, ensure the file remains unchanged.
